name: Marketing Agents
description: Campaign, content, and audience vocabulary + starter questions (IBM ai-agents-in-marketing: content generation, campaign orchestration, social listening, personalization).
starter_prompts: Draft launch content for our Q4 campaign and adapt it per channel
Which audience segments responded best to the last three campaigns?
Summarize social listening signals about our brand this week

terminology.description: A coordinated set of marketing activities with a shared goal, audience, and time window.
A group of prospects/customers sharing attributes used for targeting. Distinct from a 'channel' (where content is delivered).
Monitoring public channels for brand/product mentions to detect trends and sentiment.
Customer Acquisition Cost — total marketing spend divided by customers acquired in a period.
Tailoring content/offers to an individual based on their data — agents propose, humans approve outbound sends.
Share of audience members completing the target action (purchase, signup) after exposure.
